world <- getMap(resolution = "high")
world_sf <- st_as_sf(world)

bal_countries <- c("Sweden")

world_bal <- world_sf[
  world_sf$ADMIN %in% bal_countries,
]

Coord <- data.frame(
  latitude = 60.3945,
  longitude = 18.1824,
  names = "Forsmark"
)
baltic <- ggplot() +
  geom_sf(
    data = world_bal,
    fill = NA,
    colour = "black"
  ) +
  geom_point(
    data = Coord,
    aes(
      x = longitude,
      y = latitude
    ),
    size = 6,
    colour = "firebrick"
  ) +
  coord_sf(
    xlim = c(10, 28),
    ylim = c(55, 70),
    expand = FALSE
  ) +
  theme_classic() +
  xlab("Longitude") +
  ylab("Latitude") +
  theme(
    text = element_text(color = "black"),
    axis.text.x = element_text(
      size = 14,
      color = "black"
    ),
    axis.text.y = element_text(
      size = 14,
      color = "black"

Geochemical data

Gasdata_KFM <- read_excel("Gasdata_all.xlsx", 
                               sheet = "Rtable", col_types = c("text", 
                                                                         "numeric", "numeric", "numeric", 
                                                                         "numeric", "numeric", "numeric", 
                                                                         "numeric", "numeric", "numeric", 
                                                                         "numeric", "numeric", "numeric", 
                                                                         "numeric", "numeric", "numeric", 
                                                                         "numeric", "numeric", "numeric", 
                                                                         "numeric", "numeric", "numeric", 
                                                                         "text", "date", "numeric", "numeric", 
                                                                         "numeric", "numeric", "text", "text", 
                                                                         "text", "numeric","numeric"))
## Warning: Expecting numeric in AG3 / R3C33: got 'KFM'
Gasdata_KFM$H2[Gasdata_KFM$H2 == 0] <- 1e-3  

Gasdata_KFM$Source <- as.factor(Gasdata_KFM$Source)

Gasdata_KFM <- Gasdata_KFM %>%
  mutate(Name = paste(Borehole, Section, sep = ":"))

HydroChemTable_May21_HD <- read_excel("HydroChemTable_May21_HD.xlsx", 
                                             skip = 2)
## New names:
## • `` -> `...56`
## • `` -> `...198`
SKBdata <- HydroChemTable_May21_HD %>%
  mutate(Name = paste(IDCODE, SectionCode, sep = ":"))
relevant_names <- unique(Gasdata_KFM$Name)
SKB_filtered <- SKBdata %>%
  filter(Name %in% relevant_names)

SKB_summary <- SKB_filtered %>%
  group_by(Name) %>%
  summarise(
    sulfate = mean(`SO4(mg/l)`, na.rm = TRUE),
    Temperature = mean(`Temperature for modelling`, na.rm = TRUE),
    pH = mean(`PH(pH)`, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

Gasdata_KFM2 <- Gasdata_KFM %>%
  left_join(SKB_summary, by = "Name")

Gasdata_KFM2 %>%
  summarise(
    n = n(),
    ph_mean = mean(pH, na.rm = TRUE),
    ph_sd = sd(pH, na.rm = TRUE),
    ph_cv = ph_sd / ph_mean
  )
## # A tibble: 1 × 4
##       n ph_mean ph_sd  ph_cv
##   <int>   <dbl> <dbl>  <dbl>
## 1    37    7.71 0.534 0.0692
env <- Gasdata_KFM2[c(32, 33, 43,44), ]

### Figure 3

cols.gas <- c( "HE"= '#56B4E9',"CO2" ="#009E73", "N2"= "#0072B2", "H2"= "#D55E00", "CH4"=  "#CC79A7", "C2H6"= "#F0E442", "C3H8"="#E69F00" , "O₂+Ar"="purple")

gasdata <- melt(Gasdata_KFM, id.vars =c("Borehole", "Section", "WaterType", "Comments on Values", "Source", "Sample_date", "Elevation", "NORTHING_WC_SECMID", "EASTING_WC_SECMID",'Name'))

filtered_data <- gasdata %>%
  filter((variable %in% c("HE","CO2", "N2", "H2", "CH4", "C2H6", "C3H8","O₂+Ar")))

filtered_data_sum <- filtered_data %>%
  group_by(Name, variable) %>%
  summarise(value = sum(value, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

# Normalise to proportions
filtered_data_norm <- filtered_data_sum %>%
  group_by(Name) %>%
  mutate(total = sum(value),
         proportion = value / total * 100) %>%
  ungroup()

filtered_data_norm$variable <- factor(
  filtered_data_norm$variable,
  levels = names(cols.gas)
)

filtered_data_norm <- filtered_data_norm %>%
  group_by(variable) %>%
  mutate(total_prop = sum(proportion)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(variable = factor(variable, levels = unique(variable[order(total_prop)])))

ggplot(filtered_data_norm, aes(x = Name, y = proportion, fill = variable)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = cols.gas) +
  labs(y = "Gas Proportion (%)", x = "Borehole", fill = "Gas") +
  theme_minimal(base_family = "", base_size = 14) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1, vjust = 0.5))  +
  theme(panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank(), text = element_text(color = "black"),
    legend.title=element_blank(), 
        axis.text.x=element_text(size=14,, color = "black"),
        axis.text.y=element_text(size=14,, color = "black"),
        legend.key.size = unit(0.3, "cm"), 
        axis.title = element_text(size = 16),
        legend.justification = c(1, 0.5),       
        legend.text = element_text(size = 15), 
        legend.direction = "vertical"        
  )

clean_taxonomy <- function(df) {
  df %>%
    mutate(species = gsub("[a-z]__", "", species)) %>%
    separate(
      species,
      into = c("domain","phylum","class","order","family","genus","species"),
      sep = ";",
      fill = "right",
      remove = FALSE
    ) %>%
    mutate(across(
      c(domain, phylum, class, order, family, genus, species),
      ~ ifelse(.x %in% c("unclassified", "Unclassified", "", NA),
               "Unclassified", as.character(.x))
    )) %>%
    filter(domain != "unmapped") %>%
    mutate(taxon = coalesce(species, genus, family, order, class, phylum))
}

get_dominant_family <- function(long_df, min_abund = 0.01, min_samples = 2) {
  long_df %>%
    group_by(family, sample) %>%
    summarise(rel_abund = sum(abundance), .groups = "drop") %>%
    mutate(flag = rel_abund >= min_abund) %>%
    group_by(family) %>%
    summarise(n_samples = sum(flag), .groups = "drop") %>%
    filter(n_samples >= min_samples) %>%
    pull(family)
}

make_plot_df <- function(long_df, family_to_show) {
  long_df %>%
    mutate(
      family_plot = case_when(
        family %in% family_to_show ~ family,
        family == "Unclassified" ~ "Unclassified",
        TRUE ~ "Other"
      )
    ) %>%
    group_by(sample, family_plot) %>%
    summarise(abundance = sum(abundance), .groups = "drop")
}

DNA_plot_df <- make_plot_df(bintax_long_DNA, family_to_show)
RNA_plot_df <- make_plot_df(bintax_long_RNA, family_to_show)

family_order <- function(plot_df) {
  plot_df %>%
    group_by(family_plot) %>%
    mutate(total_abundance = sum(abundance)) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    mutate(
      family_plot = fct_reorder(family_plot, total_abundance, .desc = TRUE),
      family_plot = fct_relevel(family_plot, "Other", "Unclassified", after = Inf)
    ) %>%
    dplyr::select(-total_abundance)
}

DNA_plot_df <- family_order(DNA_plot_df)
RNA_plot_df <- family_order(RNA_plot_df)

DNA_plot_familyified <- DNA_plot_df %>% filter(family_plot != "Unclassified")
RNA_plot_familyified <- RNA_plot_df %>% filter(family_plot != "Unclassified")

parse_tax <- function(df, col) {
  df %>%
    mutate(tax = gsub("[a-z]__", "", .data[[col]])) %>%
    separate(
      tax,
      into = c("domain","phylum","class","order","family","genus","species_rank"),
      sep = ";",
      fill = "right",
      remove = FALSE
    )
}

    tibble(
      species = acet_meth_merged$species,
      
      family = acet_meth_merged$family_DNA,
      order = acet_meth_merged$order_DNA,
      phylum = acet_meth_merged$phylum_DNA,
      domain = acet_meth_merged$domain_DNA,

    )
  },

) %>%

    by = "pair"
  )

    family != ""

    site,
    sample,
    domain,
    phylum,
    order,
    family
  ) %>%
  summarise(
    DNA = sum(DNA.x, na.rm = TRUE),
    RNA = sum(RNA.x, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  
  mutate(
    log2ratio = log2(
      (RNA + eps) /
        (DNA + eps)
    )
  )

family_abundance <- activity_family %>%
  group_by(
    domain,
    phylum,
    order,
    family
  ) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_DNA = mean(DNA, na.rm = TRUE),
    max_DNA = max(DNA, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

abundance_threshold <- 0.0000001
families_to_keep <- family_abundance %>%
  filter(
    max_DNA >= abundance_threshold
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(
    domain,
    phylum,
    order,
    family
  )

activity_family_filtered <- activity_family %>%
  semi_join(
    families_to_keep,
    by = c(
      "domain",
      "phylum",
      "order",
      "family"
    )
  )

activity_family_filtered <- activity_family_filtered %>%
  mutate(
    domain = if_else(
      is.na(domain) | domain == "",
      "Unclassified",
      domain
    ),
    phylum = if_else(
      is.na(phylum) | phylum == "",
      "Unclassified",
      phylum
    ),
    order = if_else(
      is.na(order) | order == "",
      "Unclassified",
      order
    )
  )

# calculate DNA abundance per phylum
phylum_abundance <- activity_family_filtered %>%
  group_by(
    domain,
    phylum
  ) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_DNA = mean(DNA, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    domain_order = case_when(
      domain == "Archaea" ~ 1,
      domain == "Bacteria" ~ 2,
      TRUE ~ 3
    )
  )

  arrange(mean_DNA)

    order,
    family
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    phylum = factor(
      phylum,
      levels = phylum_levels
    )
  ) %>%
  arrange(
    phylum,
    family
  )

family_levels <- family_order_table$family

  mutate(
    phylum = factor(

      levels = phylum_levels
    ),
    family = factor(

  "KFM24-1"  = "KFM24-1",
  "KFM24-2"  = "KFM24-2",
  "KFM24-3"  = "KFM24-3",
  "KFM04-A-DNA1" = "KFM04A-1",
  "KFM04-A-DNA2" = "KFM04A-2",
  "KFM04-A-DNA3" = "KFM04A-3",
  "KFM04-A-DNA4" = "KFM04A-4",
  "KFM10-A-DNA1" = "KFM10A-1",
  "KFM10-A-DNA2" = "KFM10A-2"
)

rename_RNA <- c(
  "Forsmark.KFM04A.FH1.20231020.1" = "KFM04A-1",
  "Forsmark.KFM04A.FH2.20231020.2" = "KFM04A-2",
  "Forsmark.KFM04A.FH1.20231019.1" = "KFM04A-3",
  "Forsmark.KFM04A.FH2.20231019.2" = "KFM04A-4",
  "Forsmark.KFM04A.culture" = "KFM04A-culture",
  "Forsmark.KFM10A.FH3.20231020.1" = "KFM10A-1",
  "Forsmark.KFM10A.FH4.20231020.2" = "KFM10A-2"
)

names(DNA_cov) <- ifelse(
  names(DNA_cov) %in% names(rename_DNA),
  rename_DNA[names(DNA_cov)],
  names(DNA_cov)
)

names(RNA_cov) <- ifelse(
  names(RNA_cov) %in% names(rename_RNA),
  rename_RNA[names(RNA_cov)],
  names(RNA_cov)
)

# Keep only Forsmark KFM samples
DNA_cov <- DNA_cov %>%
  dplyr::select(
    KO,
    KO_name,
    dplyr::starts_with("KFM")
  )
RNA_cov <- RNA_cov %>%
  dplyr::select(
    KO,
    KO_name,
    dplyr::starts_with("KFM")
  )

#pivot to long format
DNA_long <- DNA_cov %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = -c(KO, KO_name), names_to = "sample", values_to = "coverage") %>%
  mutate(type = "DNA")

RNA_long <- RNA_cov %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = -c(KO, KO_name), names_to = "sample", values_to = "coverage") %>%
  mutate(type = "RNA")

cov_long <- bind_rows(DNA_long, RNA_long)

cov_long <- cov_long %>% mutate(coverage = as.numeric(coverage))

# join pathways
Methanogenesis_genes <- read_excel("Methanogenesis genes.xlsx")
cov_long <- cov_long %>%
  left_join(Methanogenesis_genes, by = "KO") %>%
  filter(!is.na(Pathway))   # drop KOs not in target pathways


cov_long <- cov_long %>%
  mutate(
    sample_base = sub("-.*$", "", sample)
  )

pathway_size <- Methanogenesis_genes %>%
  group_by(Pathway) %>%
  summarise(total_KOs = n_distinct(KO), .groups = "drop")

pathway_completeness <- cov_long %>%
  filter(coverage > 0) %>%                # KO detected
  group_by(sample_base, type, Pathway) %>%
  summarise(
    KOs_present = n_distinct(KO),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  left_join(pathway_size, by = "Pathway") %>%
  mutate(
    completeness = KOs_present / total_KOs
  )

pathway_completeness <- pathway_completeness %>%
  mutate(
    completeness_class = case_when(
      completeness == 1 ~ "Complete",
      completeness >= 0.5 ~ "Partial",
      TRUE ~ "Partial"
    )
  )

# aggregate per sample_base, type, and pathway
cov_pathway_sample <- cov_long %>%
  group_by(sample_base, type, Pathway) %>%
  summarise(
    KOs_present = n_distinct(KO[coverage > 0]),
    coverage = sum(coverage, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  left_join(pathway_size, by = "Pathway") %>%
  mutate(
    completeness = KOs_present / total_KOs,
    log_cov = log10(coverage + 1)
  )

cov_pathway_sample <- cov_pathway_sample %>%
  mutate(
    completeness_class = case_when(
      completeness == 1 ~ "Complete",
      completeness >= 0.5 ~ "Partial",
      TRUE ~ "Partial"
    )
  )
pathway_colors <- c( c(
  "#d95f02",  # orange
  "#0072B2"  # Blue

))
ggplot(cov_pathway_sample, aes(x = Pathway, y = sample_base, size = log_cov, color = completeness_class)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.9) +
 # facet_grid(Site ~ type, scales = "free_y", space = "free_y") +
  scale_size_continuous(name = "log10 (Coverage +1)", range = c(0, 10)) +
  scale_color_manual(values = pathway_colors, guide = guide_legend(title = "Pathway")) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle =90, hjust = 1, vjust = 0.4, size = 12, face = "italic", colour= 'black'),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 12, colour = 'black', hjust = 1, vjust = 1),
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14),
    panel.grid.major = element_line(color = "grey90"),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.spacing = unit(1, "lines"),
    legend.position = "right",
    legend.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 10)
  ) +
  labs(x = "Pathway", y = "Sample")

comm <- as.data.frame(t(DNA))

richness <- specnumber(comm)

shannon <- diversity(comm, index = "shannon")

evenness <- shannon / log(richness)

alpha_div <- data.frame(
  sample = rownames(comm),
  richness = richness,
  shannon = shannon,

  evenness = evenness
)

alpha_div
##            sample richness  shannon  evenness
## KFM02A_2 KFM02A_2      465 2.653662 0.4320491
## KFM02A_3 KFM02A_3      471 2.633850 0.4279303
## KFM02A_5 KFM02A_5      469 2.608829 0.4241582
## KFM24_1   KFM24_1      387 2.297839 0.3856454
## KFM24_2   KFM24_2      422 2.346177 0.3881183
## KFM24_3   KFM24_3      424 2.326197 0.3845124
## KFM04A_1 KFM04A_1      486 2.386358 0.3857546
## KFM04A_2 KFM04A_2      487 2.297978 0.3713446
## KFM04A_3 KFM04A_3      484 2.233931 0.3613557
## KFM04A_4 KFM04A_4      485 2.253962 0.3644742
## KFM10A_1 KFM10A_1      487 3.152281 0.5093967
## KFM10A_2 KFM10A_2      486 3.157098 0.5103445
alpha_div <- alpha_div %>%
  mutate(borehole = sub("_.*", "", sample))  # extract borehole from sample name

shapiro.test(alpha_div$shannon)
## 
##  Shapiro-Wilk normality test
## 
## data:  alpha_div$shannon
## W = 0.79434, p-value = 0.008085
kruskal.test(shannon ~ borehole, data = alpha_div)
## 
##  Kruskal-Wallis rank sum test
## 
## data:  shannon by borehole
## Kruskal-Wallis chi-squared = 8.8333, df = 3, p-value = 0.03159
kruskal.test(richness ~ borehole, data = alpha_div)
## 
##  Kruskal-Wallis rank sum test
## 
## data:  richness by borehole
## Kruskal-Wallis chi-squared = 9.6444, df = 3, p-value = 0.02184
kruskal.test(evenness ~ borehole, data = alpha_div)
## 
##  Kruskal-Wallis rank sum test
## 
## data:  evenness by borehole
## Kruskal-Wallis chi-squared = 9.3718, df = 3, p-value = 0.02474
pairwise.wilcox.test(alpha_div$shannon,
                     alpha_div$borehole,
                     p.adjust.method = "BH")
## 
##  Pairwise comparisons using Wilcoxon rank sum exact test 
## 
## data:  alpha_div$shannon and alpha_div$borehole 
## 
##        KFM02A KFM04A KFM10A
## KFM04A 0.24   -      -     
## KFM10A 0.24   0.24   -     
## KFM24  0.24   0.63   0.24  
## 
## P value adjustment method: BH
shannon <- ggplot(alpha_div, aes(x = borehole, y = shannon, fill = borehole)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA, alpha = 0.6) +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.01, size = 2, color = "black") +  # add individual points
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title = "Shannon",
       x = NULL,
       y = NULL) +
  theme(text = element_text(size = 14),
        axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90),
        legend.position = "none")


evenness <- ggplot(alpha_div, aes(x = borehole, y = evenness, fill = borehole)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA, alpha = 0.6) +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.01, size = 2, color = "black") +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title = "Evenness",
       x = NULL,
       y = NULL) +
  theme(text = element_text(size = 14),
        axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90),
        legend.position = "none")

richness <- ggplot(alpha_div, aes(x = borehole, y = richness, fill = borehole)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA, alpha = 0.6) +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.01, size = 2, color = "black") +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title = "Species richness",
       x = NULL,
       y = NULL) +
  theme(text = element_text(size = 14),
        axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90),
        legend.position = "none")

barplots_diversity <- ggarrange(shannon, richness, evenness,

# Fit envfit
ef <- envfit(rda_model, env_num, permutations = 999)

# site scores for plotting
site_scores <- as.data.frame(scores(rda_model, display = "sites", scaling = 2))
site_scores$sample <- rownames(site_scores)
site_scores$borehole <- borehole

# Extract only significant vectors for plotting 
env_vectors <- as.data.frame(scores(ef, display = "vectors", scaling = 2))
env_vectors$variable <- rownames(env_vectors)
env_vectors <- env_vectors[ef$vectors$pvals <= 0.05, ]  # only significant

var_explained <- summary(rda_model)$cont$importance[2, 1:2] * 100

hulls <- site_scores %>%
  group_by(borehole) %>%
  slice(chull(RDA1, PC1))

# Range of site scores 
max_range <- max(abs(c(site_scores$RDA1, site_scores$PC1)))

# Autoscale environmental arrows to 60% of plot range
env_vectors$RDA1 <- env_vectors$RDA1 / max(abs(env_vectors$RDA1)) * max_range 
env_vectors$PC1  <- env_vectors$PC1  / max(abs(env_vectors$PC1))  * max_range 

env_vectors$lab_x <- env_vectors$RDA1 * 1.05
env_vectors$lab_y <- env_vectors$PC1  * 1.0
ggplot() +
  geom_polygon(data = hulls,
               aes(RDA1, PC1, fill = borehole),
               alpha = 0.2,
               color = NA) +
  geom_point(data = site_scores,
             aes(RDA1, PC1, color = borehole),
             size = 4) +
  geom_segment(data = env_vectors,
               aes(x = 0, y = 0, xend = RDA1, yend = PC1),
               arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.35, "cm")),
               color = "black",
               linewidth = 0.7) +
  geom_text(data = env_vectors,
            aes(RDA1, PC1, label = variable),
            size = 4.5,
            color = "black",
            vjust = -1) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey60") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey60") +
  scale_x_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = 0.20)) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = 0.20))  +
  coord_equal() +
  theme_classic(base_size = 14) +
  labs(
    title = "Redundancy Analysis (RDA) of Microbial Communities",
    x = paste0("RDA1 (", round(var_explained[1], 1), "%)"),
    y = paste0("PC1 (", round(var_explained[2], 1), "%)"),
    color = "Borehole",
    fill = "Borehole"
  ) +
  theme(
    text = element_text(size = 14),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 14),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 14)

dist <- vegdist(comm, method = "bray")

pcoa <- cmdscale(dist, eig = TRUE, k = 2)

scores <- as.data.frame(pcoa$points)
colnames(scores) <- c("PCoA1", "PCoA2")

scores$sample <- rownames(scores)
scores$borehole <- borehole

var_exp <- round(pcoa$eig / sum(pcoa$eig) * 100, 1)

hulls <- scores %>%
  group_by(borehole) %>%
  slice(chull(PCoA1, PCoA2))

ggplot(scores, aes(PCoA1, PCoA2, color = borehole)) +
  geom_polygon(data = hulls,
               aes(fill = borehole),
               alpha = 0.2,
               color = NA) +
  geom_point(size = 4) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey70") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey70") +
  coord_equal() +
  theme_classic(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    axis.title = element_text(size = 16),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 14, colour = "black"),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 14),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 12)
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "PCoA of Microbial Communities (Bray–Curtis)",
    x = paste0("PCoA1 (", var_exp[1], "%)"),
    y = paste0("PCoA2 (", var_exp[2], "%)"),
    color = "Borehole",
    fill = "Borehole"
  )

colnames(metaproteomeDB_proteins) <- metaproteomeDB_proteins[2, ]
metaproteomeDB_proteins <- metaproteomeDB_proteins[c(-1,-2),]

proteins <- metaproteomeDB_proteins %>%
  filter(Contaminant == "FALSE" & `Marked as` == "Metaproteome")

proteins_forsmark <- proteins %>%
  dplyr::select(
    -all_of(c("Found in Sample: F11: Sample, 06" ,"Found in Sample: F10: Sample, 05",
                     "Found in Sample: F9: Sample, 04", "Abundances Count: F11: Sample, 06",
                     "Abundances Count: F10: Sample, 05", "Abundances Count: F9: Sample, 04",
              "Abundance: F11: Sample, 06","Abundance: F10: Sample, 05","Abundance: F9: Sample, 04")))

Acetyl <- proteins_forsmark %>%
  filter(Description %in% c("Acetyl-coenzyme A synthetase", 
                            "Acetate kinase", 
                            "Phosphate acetyltransferase", 
                            "Acetyl-CoA acetyltransferase", 
                            "Carbon monoxide dehydrogenase/acetyl-CoA synthase subunit beta",
                            "Carbon monoxide dehydrogenase/acetyl-CoA synthase subunit alpha")) %>%
  dplyr::select(
    all_of(c("Description", "Abundances Count: F7: Sample, 01",
              "Abundances Count: F8: Sample, 02", "Abundances Count: F12: Sample, 03",
              "Abundance: F7: Sample, 01","Abundance: F8: Sample, 02","Abundance: F12: Sample, 03")))
Acetyl <- Acetyl%>% 
  mutate(across(-Description, ~as.numeric(.)))
Acetyl <- Acetyl %>%
  rename( "KFM04A_count1" =  "Abundances Count: F7: Sample, 01" ,
          "KFM04A_count2" = "Abundances Count: F8: Sample, 02" ,
       "KFM10A_count" = "Abundances Count: F12: Sample, 03"  ,
       "KFM04A_abundance1" = "Abundance: F7: Sample, 01"  ,
       "KFM04A_abundance2" = "Abundance: F8: Sample, 02"  ,
       "KFM10A_abundance" = "Abundance: F12: Sample, 03"  )

Acetyl <- Acetyl %>%
  mutate(
    KFM04A_count     = (KFM04A_count1 + KFM04A_count2) / 2,
    KFM04A_abundance = (KFM04A_abundance1 + KFM04A_abundance2) / 2
  )

Acetyl <- Acetyl %>%
  dplyr::select(
    -KFM04A_count1,
    -KFM04A_count2,
    -KFM04A_abundance1,
    -KFM04A_abundance2
  )

Acetyl <- Acetyl %>%
  mutate(
    Description = recode(
      Description,
      "Carbon monoxide dehydrogenase/acetyl-CoA synthase subunit beta" = "Acetyl-coenzyme A synthase subunit beta",
      "Carbon monoxide dehydrogenase/acetyl-CoA synthase subunit alpha" = "Acetyl-coenzyme A synthase subunit alpha"
    )
  )

Acetyl_counts <- Acetyl %>%
  dplyr::select(Description, contains("_count"))

Acetyl_abund <- Acetyl %>%
  dplyr::select(Description, contains("_abundance"))

abund_long <- Acetyl_abund %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -Description,
    names_to = "Sample",
    values_to = "Abundance"
  ) 

counts_long <- Acetyl_counts %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -Description,
    names_to = "Sample",
    values_to = "Count"
  ) 

abund_long <- abund_long %>%
  mutate(Sample = str_replace(Sample, "_abundance$", ""))

counts_long <- counts_long %>%
  mutate(Sample = str_replace(Sample, "_count$", ""))

order <- c(
  "Phosphate acetyltransferase",
  "Acetate kinase",
  "Acetyl-CoA acetyltransferase",
  "Acetyl-coenzyme A synthetase", 
  "Acetyl-coenzyme A synthase subunit alpha",
  "Acetyl-coenzyme A synthase subunit beta"
)
pc <- counts_long %>%
  mutate(Description = factor(Description, levels = order)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = Sample,
             y = Count,
             fill = Description)) +
  geom_col(position = "dodge") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 16) + 
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(hjust = 1,colour = "black",size = 16),
        axis.text.y = element_text(colour = "black",size = 16),
        axis.title = element_text(size = 16),
        legend.title = element_text(size = 16),
        panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
        panel.grid.minor.x = element_blank(),
        legend.position = "right",
        legend.direction = "vertical",
        legend.box = "full",
        legend.text = element_text(size = 16)) +
  labs(title = "Protein Counts per Sample")

pa <- abund_long %>%
  mutate(Description = factor(Description, levels = order)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = Sample,
             y = Abundance,
             fill = Description)) +
  geom_col(position = "dodge") +
  scale_y_log10() +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 16) + 
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(hjust = 1,colour = "black",size = 16),
        axis.text.y = element_text(colour = "black",size = 16),
        axis.title = element_text(size = 16),
        legend.title = element_text(size = 16),
        panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
        panel.grid.minor.x = element_blank(),
        legend.position = "right",
        legend.direction = "vertical",
        legend.box = "full",
        legend.text = element_text(size = 16)) +
  labs(title = "Protein Abundance per Sample (log10 scale)")

barplots_prot_forsmark <- ggarrange(pc, pa,
                                     labels = c("a", "b"),
                                     ncol = 1, nrow = 2,
                                     legend = 'right',
                                     common.legend = TRUE)
